name: Clapperboard
summary: Film slate with a black-and-white striped clapper arm, blank lines only and no text; anim clap snaps it shut.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the board rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; hero size: at s = 1 the board is about 520 px wide and 420 px tall

params.name: anim
params.note: clap = the striped arm snaps down onto the board, then lifts
